ai.sum: Iran said ships hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and warned vessels to coordinate passage.

items.title: Eisenkot ally says Israel need not strike Iran now over chemical weapons

ai.sum: An Eisenkot ally said Israel need not strike Iran now over its chemical weapons.

items.title: Iran launches fresh drone strikes on opposition group in Kurdistan Region

ai.sum: Iran carried out fresh drone strikes on an opposition group in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq.

items.title: Iraqi oil from Kurdistan smuggled into Iran and Afghanistan, government report reveals

ai.sum: A government report reveals Iraqi oil from Kurdistan was smuggled into Iran and Afghanistan.

items.title: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi refinery, financial district
items.summary: Iran-backed Yemeni Houthis say they carried out fresh retaliatory attacks in Saudi Arabia. A fire was reported at Ras Tanura oil refinery and Riyadh's financial district was attacked for the second time in a week.

ai.sum: Houthis claimed fresh retaliatory attacks in Saudi Arabia, with a fire reported at Ras Tanura refinery and Riyadh's financial district hit again.

items.title: Could Netanyahu take Israel into another war with Iran to cling to power?
items.summary: As Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot moves to form a government, could war with Iran derail talks and save Netanyahu?

ai.sum: Analysis asks whether Netanyahu could start a new war with Iran to derail coalition talks led by opposition leader Eisenkot and preserve his power.

items.title: Iran develops new ballistic missile variants, US think tanks say
items.summary: Iran appears to be developing new ballistic missile variants designed to improve its ability to strike targets and evade air defenses, even as its capacity for mass production remains unclear, two US think tanks said on Tuesday.

ai.sum: Two US think tanks say Iran is developing new ballistic missile variants meant to improve strike reach and evade air defences, with mass-production capacity unclear.

items.title: Iran tightens security measures in Strait of Hormuz: Army
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia says the military had stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz, warning that vessels must coordinate their passage with the Iranian Armed Forces to ensure safe transit.

ai.sum: Iran's army said it has stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz and requires vessels to coordinate passage with Iranian forces.

items.title: Report: North Korea helping Iran develop launch systems inside underground missile cities
items.summary: Emirati outlet Erem News cites sources familiar with White House affairs and close to CIA officials who say North Korean specialists are working remotely with Iranian technicians as Tehran seeks to rebuild its offensive capabilities

ai.sum: A report cites North Korean specialists remotely helping Iranian technicians develop launch systems inside underground missile cities.

items.title: Iraq crackdown targets oil smuggling routes to Iran

ai.sum: Iraq launched a crackdown on oil smuggling routes that move fuel to Iran.

items.title: The militia Iran says its enemies can't defeat, and the protests it has crushed
items.summary: Iran's military chiefs marked Basij Week by hailing the militia as a global power the United States and Israel cannot neutralize, months after Mojtaba Khamenei set its new commander the goal of making "every Iranian a Basiji."

ai.sum: Iran's military chiefs marked Basij Week by hailing the militia as a global power, after its new commander was tasked with making every Iranian a Basiji.
